name: Micah
title: The Prophet of Bethlehem
summary: Micah of Moreshet prophesied at the same time as Isaiah in Judah. He preached against social injustice and corrupt leaders, but is best known for the prophecy that the Messiah would be born in Bethlehem. His summary of what God requires is among the most quoted verses in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: The Prophecy about Bethlehem
keyEvents.description: Micah prophesied that the Messiah would come from the small town of Bethlehem.

keyEvents.title: Judgment on Corrupt Leaders
keyEvents.description: Micah accused Israel's leaders of hating good and loving evil.

keyEvents.title: What the Lord Requires
keyEvents.description: Micah summarized the essence of true worship: to do what is right, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God.

keyEvents.title: Hope for Restoration
keyEvents.description: Micah concluded with hope that God would show faithfulness and forgive His people.
